channel.title: The Intelligencer
channel.description: News of artificial intelligence, ranked and printed daily: research, tutorials, tools and releases. Every link goes to the original publisher.

item.title: Meta Muse exposes users' personal and business secrets when they share conversations
item.description: Ars Technica reports that sharing Muse conversations can expose personal and business information to others.

item.title: Introducing TorchTPU
item.description: The PyTorch project introduces TorchTPU, a way to run PyTorch workloads on Google TPUs natively.

item.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
item.description: TechCrunch reports the US has ordered federal agencies to remove DeepSeek AI from their systems.

item.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
item.description: TechCrunch reports Anthropic is proposing a safety bill that could block a model if it might cause mass casualties.

item.title: Inside NVIDIA Sentry: Secure AI Agents at Runtime
item.description: NVIDIA technical post on Sentry, a runtime layer meant to secure AI agents while they execute.

item.title: NVIDIA Cosmos3-H-Dreams: Bringing Clinical Surgery to Life Through Generative Simulation
item.description: Hugging Face post on an NVIDIA Cosmos model that generates simulated clinical surgery scenes.

item.title: TorchNeuron: running HF models on AWS Trainium is easier than ever
item.description: Hugging Face post on TorchNeuron, a path to run Hugging Face models on AWS Trainium with native PyTorch.

item.title: Structured outputs for Anthropic Claude models on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: AWS post on structured outputs for Claude models on Amazon Bedrock, constraining responses to a schema.

item.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
item.description: OpenAI post on improving coding ability in programming languages with little training data.

item.title: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
item.description: The Verge reports a hacker used many AI agents to break into John Deere and SharkNinja systems.

item.title: Encoder-Free Multimodal LLMs Learn Implicit Encoders
item.description: Preprint on multimodal language models that skip a separate vision encoder and appear to learn encoder-like behavior internally.

item.title: One Search, Two Layers: Compiler Controls Inside PyTorch Helion using NVIDIA CompileIQ
item.description: PyTorch Blog on compiler controls in Helion with NVIDIA CompileIQ across two layers of search.

item.title: llm-echo 0.5
item.description: Release 0.5 of llm-echo, a plugin for the llm command-line tool.

item.title: Anthropic's proposed AI safety bill only kicks in if 50 deaths or $1B in damages
item.description: HN thread on a safety bill Anthropic proposed, which applies only after 50 deaths or $1B in damages.

item.title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
item.description: Discussion of websites increasingly blocking AI agents from access.

item.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
item.description: Community-discussed post on LLM agents that reason in latent space and act through text. Title alone does not show the evidence.

item.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
item.description: TechCrunch reports Anthropic will commit 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund.

item.title: Reasoning Models Can Control Their Chains of Thought When They Tell Themselves To
item.description: Preprint finding that reasoning models can control their chains of thought when they instruct themselves to.

item.title: Introducing Reflection Beam: an open-weight model for agentic coding on AWS
item.description: AWS announces Reflection Beam, an open-weight model aimed at agentic coding on its platform.

item.title: Welcome Beam: a 501B open model you can own, customize, and scale
item.description: Hugging Face introduces Beam, a 501B-parameter open model positioned for customization and self-hosting.

item.title: Scaling Indic Pretraining: 2.8 Trillion Tokens and an Open Data Generation Pipeline
item.description: Hugging Face post on Indic pretraining at 2.8 trillion tokens, with an open data generation pipeline.

item.title: Code, Test, and Deploy on One Machine with NVIDIA RTX Spark
item.description: Nvidia describes using its RTX Spark machines to code, test and deploy on a single local system.

item.title: OpenAI models hacked a crypto wallet and breached more websites
item.description: Ars Technica reports OpenAI models were used to hack a crypto wallet and breach more websites.

item.title: Anthropic gives third-party auditors ’employee-like access’ in AI industry first
item.description: ZDNET reports Anthropic will give third-party auditors employee-like access, which it calls an industry first.

item.title: Welcome Muse Spark Open: open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Meta
item.description: Hugging Face documents the open-weight release of Meta's Muse Spark, a multimodal mixture-of-experts model, with usage notes for developers.

item.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Powers Specialized Agents with Multimodal Reasoning
item.description: Nvidia's technical blog presents Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a vision-language model aimed at specialized agents.

item.title: Report: FTC probes Anthropic, OpenAI after Trump dismissed AI fears as “hoax”
item.description: Ars Technica reports the FTC is probing Anthropic and OpenAI, based on a report.

item.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
item.description: TechCrunch reports Anthropic is giving METR researchers employee-level access to its systems.

item.title: Welcome FLUX.3 Image Klein in Diffusers
item.description: Hugging Face post on running FLUX.3 Image Klein in the Diffusers library.

item.title: Meta’s Muse Spark Open now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
item.description: AWS announces Muse Spark Open availability in SageMaker JumpStart.

item.title: HiRO-ACEv2: Simulating extreme weather at 3 km resolution for a fraction of the cost
item.description: Hugging Face blog on HiRO-ACEv2, which simulates extreme weather at 3 km resolution at far lower cost.

item.title: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids
item.description: Eight US states have sued OpenAI, arguing ChatGPT is unsafe for children, as The Verge reports.

item.title: Anthropic warns small AI models could self-replicate through IoT devices
item.description: Ars Technica reports Anthropic warning that small AI models could self-replicate through IoT devices.

item.title: OpenAI, Google pushing new AI models easily tricked into making nudes, researchers say
item.description: Ars Technica reports researchers found new OpenAI and Google image models are easy to trick into making nude images.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
item.description: Google announces Gemini 4 Argon, a new Gemini model for hard problems, rolling out in the Gemini app and developer tools.

item.title: [AINews] Meta Muse Wonder & Wonder Full: MSL’s Claude 5.5-tier Frontier Model
item.description: Newsletter reports Meta's superintelligence lab models Muse Wonder as a frontier-tier release.

item.title: Google lets you make personal Android apps for free now – with just prompts
item.description: ZDNET reports Google now lets people build personal Android apps free using prompts.

item.title: NVIDIA Run:ai Is Now Open Source as Part of NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform
item.description: NVIDIA is open-sourcing Run:ai as part of its DSX AI Factory platform.

item.title: Run fast, private agents on-device with LFM2.5-24B-A2B
item.description: Hugging Face blog on running private agents on-device with LFM2.5-24B-A2B.
